prompts.text: What would be your excuse to keep this conversation going after everyone else leaves?
Make a good first impression or leave me curious enough to ask another question?
Which detail about you would I notice only if I were paying proper attention?
We are both pretending not to notice the last seat is beside you. Who breaks first?
What is your most charming way of admitting you have forgotten someone's name?
Tell me about a time a completely ordinary introduction caught you off guard.
What should I ask if I want to see the less rehearsed version of you?
You seem like someone with a story behind that smile. Which story is safe for a first meeting?
What kind of invitation would tempt you to put your phone away for an afternoon?
The best flirting leaves the other person room to surprise you. How would you surprise me?
What would make you realise I am enjoying this more than I am letting on?
Win me over with an unexpectedly good question or an unexpectedly bad joke?
Which harmless opinion of yours is worth a little playful arguing?
We keep choosing the same queue. At what point does one of us have to say hello?
What would I learn about your sense of humour in the first ten minutes?
Tell me about a compliment you were not prepared to receive gracefully.
Which part of your personality arrives after the polite introductions?
I think a shared detour tells you more than a perfect plan. Where would you lead one?
What makes someone interesting enough for you to miss your stop in a conversation?
If I asked you to recommend one place, which choice would reveal the most about you?
How would you challenge me to impress you without making it feel like an audition?
Discover we share a favourite place or discover you have one I need to see?
What would make you glad someone approached you at exactly the wrong moment?
A friend asks how we know each other and the answer is 'about twelve minutes'. What do you add?
What is something you enjoy being teased about by someone who gets the tone right?
Tell me about a time somebody's laugh made you want to know them better.
Which interest of yours deserves a better opening line than 'so, what do you do'?
You look as though you have already decided which dessert is best. Should I trust you?
What would convince you to swap your usual order for my recommendation?
A little awkwardness can make an introduction memorable. What is your most endearing kind?
What would be the giveaway if you were trying to act cooler than you felt?
Let me pick the soundtrack or let me guess yours?
If your favourite song came on now, would I get to see a different side of you?
We both reach for the same book. Do you defend your choice or ask about mine?
What tiny act of confidence do you find unexpectedly appealing?
Tell me about a conversation which turned a boring wait into the best part of your day.
What is the least impressive skill you would still show off if I asked nicely?
I suspect your polite answer and your honest answer are different. Which question would prove it?
What would you hope I remembered about you tomorrow?
Which shared discovery would make this feel less like meeting a stranger?
What makes an invitation feel personal before two people know much about each other?
Catch me noticing your best quality or tell me what I have missed?
Which of your recommendations comes with a warning you think makes it better?
We have five minutes before we must go in different directions. What is worth saying now?
What kind of friendly competition would bring out your most charmingly stubborn side?
Tell me about a time someone made a simple goodbye surprisingly difficult.
What would I have to say to get your 'tell me more' face?
Some people make a room feel smaller in a good way. What makes you forget the room around you?
Which local secret would you share only after deciding I have decent taste?
Being a little intrigued is a better start than having everything worked out. What are you curious about so far?
Which spontaneous idea would get you saying yes before you remembered to be sensible?
Trade one surprisingly useful tip or one completely useless talent?
What is a small kindness you find difficult not to notice?
I get your favourite film completely wrong. Are you correcting me gently or enjoying the debate?
Which question do you wish people asked before they asked for your social handle?
Tell me about a time an accidental seat assignment worked out beautifully.
What would make you curious about someone whose hobbies are nothing like yours?
I like people who have a favourite corner of a city. What is yours doing right?
What is your most convincing invitation to take the scenic route?
Which expression gives away that you are trying not to laugh?
What would make a very ordinary errand better with the right company?
Who is more likely to charm the person at the next table into settling our debate?
What is your favourite way for a conversation to go slightly off script?
We agree to recommend each other one thing by tomorrow. What category gives you the advantage?
What detail in someone's voice makes you want to keep listening?
Tell me about a time you were pleasantly surprised by who you clicked with.
Which outing would reveal your playful side faster than a formal dinner?
There is a story in the way you said 'usually'. What is the exception?
How good are you at keeping a straight face when you know someone is flirting?
A confident 'I have no idea' has its own appeal. What would you happily admit not knowing?
What do you enjoy explaining to someone who is interested for the right reasons?
Choose the next stop together or each suggest somewhere and let curiosity decide?
Which small adventure would you say yes to with very little planning?
We have opposite views on a song playing nearby. How do you make your case charmingly?
What would give someone away as a good listener without them saying much?
Tell me about an invitation you accepted because the wording made you smile.
What is something I should not mistake for you being uninterested?
You seem comfortable with a little mystery. Which fact would spoil yours too soon?
Which part of a person's enthusiasm tends to win you over?
What would be a pleasantly bold question to ask before this coffee gets cold?
What would make you smile if you found a note with a recommendation from me?
Let me see your competitive side or your hopeless-at-this side first?
Which assumption about your taste would be fun for me to get wrong?
We are introduced twice by two different people. What do you say the second time?
Which dance would you be willing to teach someone with more enthusiasm than coordination?
Tell me about a time you noticed chemistry before you had a word for it.
Which side of you would come out if we got caught in unexpected rain?
A good conversation sometimes makes leaving feel oddly formal. How would you end this one?
What would make a quiet invitation more appealing than a grand gesture?
A person who remembers how you take your tea has a head start. What little detail matters to you?
What small sign would tell you I took your recommendation seriously?
Be the person with a plan or the person who makes the plan more interesting?
Which unexpected shared preference would make you laugh right now?
If we tried something neither of us was good at, who would start laughing first?
What would you call this conversation if it were the opening scene of a film?
Tell me about a time someone made you feel interesting without asking a single impressive question.
What is your way of saying 'I am enjoying your company' without those exact words?
Which accent or expression do you find yourself borrowing from people you enjoy being around?
What would you put on a tiny menu designed to show off your excellent taste to me?
If we pick this conversation up another day, where should we begin?
